    cf3 = c3 + p3
    pv3_at2 = cf3 / (1 + y)
    call_pay = Q("1.03") * out3
    call = call_pay < pv3_at2
    t = Q(330, 360)
    third = call_pay if call else cf3
    price = (cf1 / (1 + y) ** (1 - t)
             + cf2 / (1 + y) ** (2 - t)
             + third / (1 + y) ** (3 - t))
    # if called, the call payment is received at end of year 2, plus year-2 payment
    if call:
        price = (cf1 / (1 + y) ** (1 - t)
                 + (cf2 + call_pay) / (1 + y) ** (2 - t))
    year2_total = cf2 + (call_pay if call else Q(0))
    return {
        "final": price,
        "principal_after_year2": out3,
        "pv_year3_at_year2": pv3_at2,
        "call_decision": "call" if call else "no_call",
        "year2_total_received": year2_total,
    }

def solve():
    face = Q(2000)
    y = Q("0.075")
    p1 = face * Q("0.35")
    p2 = face * Q("0.40")
    out1 = face
    out2 = face - p1
    p3 = face - p1 - p2
    r1 = Q("6.5") / 100
    r2 = r1 - Q(1, 100)
    r3 = r2
    c1 = r1 * out1
    c2 = r2 * out2
    c3 = r3 * p3
    cf1 = p1 + c1
    cf2 = p2 + c2
    cf3 = p3 + c3
    pv3_at2 = cf3 / (1 + y)
    call_pay = Q("1.03") * p3
    call = call_pay < pv3_at2
    t = Q(330, 360)
    if call:
        last = call_pay
        last_k = 2
    else:
        last = cf3
        last_k = 3
    price = cf1 / (1 + y) ** (1 - t)
    if call:
        price += (cf2 + call_pay) / (1 + y) ** (2 - t)
        y2 = cf2 + call_pay
    else:
        price += cf2 / (1 + y) ** (2 - t) + cf3 / (1 + y) ** (3 - t)
        y2 = cf2
    return {
        "final": price,
        "principal_after_year2": p3,
        "pv_year3_at_year2": pv3_at2,
        "call_decision": "call" if call else "no_call",
